# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen or seventeen years old by the end of Volume 2  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v2 c26 P5](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0005)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Unmarried; engaged to the Spencervale schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v2 c26 P48](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0048)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a very handsome, showy girl with a brilliant complexion and long, thick, golden-yellow hair that she wears in braids or done up elegantly. She has large, bright-blue eyes, a plump figure, and is known for her attractive looks and sweet smiles. On special occasions, she wears fancy clothes, such as a cream silk blouse or pink silk waists, often adorning her hair with flowers.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## Personality

Ruby is cheerful, good-tempered, and highly emotional, often prone to tears, giggling, or fainting spells. She is immensely preoccupied with boys, romance, and flirtation, constantly boasting about her suitors and compliments. Though somewhat sentimental and shallow in her interests, she enjoys the pleasant things in life frankly and holds no deep malice, even if she occasionally engages in small schoolgirl rivalries.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## History

Ruby Gillis grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry. She became part of the 'Story Club' created by Anne, though her contributions were noted for being overly sentimental. Encouraged by Miss Stacy, Ruby joined the advanced class studying for the entrance examinations to Queen's Academy, successfully passing and moving to Kingsport to attend college. After completing her studies and obtaining a Second Class teacher's license, she accepted a position to teach at the Carmody school. Throughout her school years and young womanhood, Ruby was famous among her peers for her numerous romantic interests and flirtations. Following her time at Queen's, she became engaged to the Spencervale schoolteacher.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P48](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0048), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_
